nodes.label: Dark-Mode Design Token System
nodes.rationale: Dark mode only on #0a0c0f with brand accents --buy #00e5a0, --sell #ff4d6d, --neutral #f5a623, --gold #c9a84c; the neutral token's Tailwind utility was renamed to warn to avoid clashing with Tailwind's built-in neutral palette. Typography: Playfair Display (display), IBM Plex Sans (body), IBM Plex Mono (numbers/tickers).

edges.source_location: frontend for the multi-agent financial analysis system
